title: 光學輸入輸出小晶片
summary: 從通道、光波長、能量及端到端可用容量拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate lanes, optical wavelengths, energy and end-to-end usable capacity, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

stages.title: 容量定義與介面
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「容量定義與介面」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine capacity definitions and interfaces, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 單向與雙向：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「單向與雙向」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for direction accounting, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「單向與雙向」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。每方向容量要獨立列示，雙向相加只是特定總量定義。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「依算例由通道數乘資料率重算，保留編碼及 FEC 開銷。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for direction accounting, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. List capacities per direction; their sum is a particular aggregate convention. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Recalculate lanes times rate and retain coding/FEC overhead. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 依算例由通道數乘資料率重算，保留編碼及 FEC 開銷。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate lanes times rate and retain coding/FEC overhead.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：零錯誤測試等於證明 BER 精確為零。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Zero observed errors proves exactly zero BER. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交單向與雙向的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「依算例由通道數乘資料率重算，保留編碼及 FEC 開銷。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for direction accounting, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Recalculate lanes times rate and retain coding/FEC overhead.

steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Recalculate lanes times rate and retain coding/FEC overhead. steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「電介面相容」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。資料率相同不保證電壓擺幅、時鐘、編碼或訓練相容。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「建立發射、接收和管理的介面協議表，逐項找缺失。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。 假設每方向 64 通道、每通道 32 Gb/s，則單向=2.048 Tb/s，雙向合計=4.096 Tb/s。若有效負載比例 0.90，單向有效=1.8432 Tb/s。另假設完整光 I/O 功耗 10 W，按單向有效容量計為 5.43 pJ/bit；若改用雙向分母，必須也定義同時雙向負載。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for electrical compatibility, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Equal data rate does not establish swing, clock, coding or training compatibility. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Build transmitter, receiver and management agreements and identify gaps. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. Assume 64 lanes per direction at 32 Gb/s: 2.048 Tb/s one way and 4.096 Tb/s aggregate. At 90% payload, one-way useful capacity is 1.8432 Tb/s. A hypothetical 10 W complete optical-I/O budget gives 5.43 pJ/bit on that denominator; bidirectional accounting must specify simultaneous traffic.

steps.objective: 以「電介面相容」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for electrical compatibility, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。建立發射、接收和管理的介面協議表，逐項找缺失。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「資料率相同不保證電壓擺幅、時鐘、編碼或訓練相容。」與錯誤假說「零錯誤測試等於證明 BER 精確為零。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 假設每方向 64 通道、每通道 32 Gb/s，則單向=2.048 Tb/s，雙向合計=4.096 Tb/s。若有效負載比例 0.90，單向有效=1.8432 Tb/s。另假設完整光 I/O 功耗 10 W，按單向有效容量計為 5.43 pJ/bit；若改用雙向分母，必須也定義同時雙向負載。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Build transmitter, receiver and management agreements and identify gaps. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Equal data rate does not establish swing, clock, coding or training compatibility." against the incorrect hypothesis "Zero observed errors proves exactly zero BER."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. Assume 64 lanes per direction at 32 Gb/s: 2.048 Tb/s one way and 4.096 Tb/s aggregate. At 90% payload, one-way useful capacity is 1.8432 Tb/s. A hypothetical 10 W complete optical-I/O budget gives 5.43 pJ/bit on that denominator; bidirectional accounting must specify simultaneous traffic.
steps.observation: 建立發射、接收和管理的介面協議表，逐項找缺失。
steps.observationEn: Build transmitter, receiver and management agreements and identify gaps.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：零錯誤測試等於證明 BER 精確為零。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Zero observed errors proves exactly zero BER. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交電介面相容的量測判別表：建立發射、接收和管理的介面協議表，逐項找缺失。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for electrical compatibility: Build transmitter, receiver and management agreements and identify gaps. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: R=NlaneRlaneηpayload；零錯誤 Poisson 近似的95%上界約 3/Nbits。 通道參數是教學設計，並非複製某晶片所有規格；BER 近似假設獨立稀少錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: R=NlaneRlaneηpayload; a zero-error Poisson approximation gives a 95% BER upper bound of about 3/Nbits. Lane inputs are educational, not a complete device specification; BER approximation assumes rare independent errors.
